frequency_question: How often do announced liquidity management measures fall precisely within the specified date boundaries and nomenclature of the formal criteria?
membership_rule: Includes any formal official announcement or notification by the central bank regarding the specific liquidity tool name within the target date window. Excludes general rate hikes or standard reserve requirement changes under different terminology.
coverage_note: 4 named instances of specific liquidity tool implementations by the central bank over the past decade.
known_gaps: Excludes minor operational tweaks that did not use the exact incremental nomenclature.
skeleton: Central bank policy tool announcements meeting specific nomenclature within a designated calendar window.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 4 relevant historical liquidity instrument variants matching nomenclature and timing constraints.
validity_reason: Central bank institutional announcement frameworks and legal naming conventions remain stable over multi-year horizons.
